content:
Hey everyone! :wave: I’m a software developer from the Philippines, mainly working on Full Stack & AI projects.

A few years ago, I teamed up with someone in the U.S. who already had a job. We found a setup that worked really well — he helped with opportunities and connections, while I handled the development, clients, and projects.

He recently moved on to something new, so I’m looking to build a similar partnership again with someone based in North America, Europe, Australia, or Latin America.

You don’t need to be a developer or have a technical background. I’m mainly looking for someone reliable, communicative, and interested in building something long-term.

If you’re curious about how it works, just send me a message. Happy to chat. :slight_smile:
